candidates.title: Civitai prompt 145332837
candidates.prompt:
Framing: High angle, three-quarter. The view looks down from above the near river bank, the little bridge crossing from the lower left corner towards the centre and the cobbled street climbing on to the cathedral at the upper right, its twin spires reaching the top edge.

A busy seek-and-find picture-book illustration, a crowded full-page puzzle picture in clean even black ink outlines and flat, unshaded bright colour, drawn rather than photographed, packed edge to edge with hundreds of small cartoon people in one simple rounded style, each busy with something different, the grown-ups about seven heads tall. Evenly lit and crisp down to the smallest figure. Ostrów Tumski, Wrocław's old cathedral island, at lamp-lighting time. The small green iron Tumski bridge crosses the river Odra, its railings hung with hundreds of coloured padlocks, and a cobbled street of tall iron gas lamps runs up to the red-brick cathedral with its two green copper spires. A busker plays an accordion by the bridge. Halfway along the bridge the city's lamplighter, a man in a long black cape with his grey hair blowing loose in the wind, holds his long brass pole up to a lamp and looks around, puzzled. The crowd is ordinary present-day Wrocław people of all ages and builds, a few small children in bright coats holding grown-ups' hands, everyone fully dressed in autumn coats, jumpers, scarves and woolly hats in red, blue, orange, mustard yellow, brown and grey. Evening crowds stroll arm in arm over the bridge and up the street; a couple clips a padlock to the railing, a man feeds the swans from the river wall, a photographer stands at a tripod. On the bridge and up the street, between the strolling groups, lie four small open patches of clear empty cobbles, each about the size of a café table.

A deep blue evening sky, every lit lamp warm yellow, still bright and easy to read. Every named figure clearly separate from every other figure with space between them.

candidates.title: Civitai prompt 145231788
candidates.prompt:
WORLD / SCENE IDENTITY

Masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic. A quiet old rural village at dusk, with weathered plaster houses, red clay roof tiles, dark garden trees, simple rooftop antennas, and a broad evening sky transitioning from warm sunset color into cool blue-green twilight.

The atmosphere feels calm, intimate, slightly mysterious, and deeply nostalgic.

MAIN ANCHOR

One single black adult cat sits alone on the sloping red-tiled roof of an old house.

Use natural feline anatomy:

compact seated body,
upright ears,
long relaxed tail resting along the roof,
soft dense black fur,
and small reflective yellow-green eyes.

The cat looks upward toward the crescent moon.

Keep the cat mostly in dark silhouette, clearly separated against the brighter sky.

ROOF / ARCHITECTURE

Use an old countryside house with:

aged pale plaster walls,
weathered terracotta roof tiles,
slightly irregular roof construction,
small patches of climbing vegetation,
and restrained signs of age.

The roof should descend diagonally across the image and create the main physical platform beneath the cat.

VISUAL ROUTE

Build one clear visual route:

dark vegetation
-> sloping terracotta roof
-> black cat silhouette
-> small rooftop antenna
-> glowing sunset clouds
-> crescent moon.

CAMERA

Use a vertical environmental composition from a slightly lower viewpoint, looking gently upward toward the cat on the roof.

Keep substantial open sky around the cat and moon.

Do not frame the cat too closely.

FOREGROUND / FRAMING

Use dark leafy branches and parts of nearby trees along the upper and side edges.

Keep them quiet and mostly silhouetted so they naturally frame the scene.

BACKGROUND

Use:

another modest village house,
dark tree crowns,
one simple rooftop antenna,
and very little distant architectural clutter.

Keep the lower village subdued so the roof silhouette and sky remain dominant.

SKY / LIGHT EVENT

Use a dramatic but soft dusk sky.

Near the horizon:
warm coral,
soft salmon,
peach,
and restrained orange.

Higher in the sky:
muted teal,
blue-green,
and cool gray-blue.

Use broad irregular cloud bands catching the remaining sunset light.

One small warm ivory crescent moon hangs high above the roof.

LIGHT

The remaining sunset softly illuminates:

terracotta roof edges,
selected plaster surfaces,
tree leaves,
and the outer edge of the cat’s fur.

The cat remains predominantly dark.

Keep shadows open enough to preserve its body silhouette and tail.

COLOR

BASE:
deep teal,
charcoal,
dark green,
weathered terracotta,
muted plaster gray.

COUNTER:
coral,
soft peach,
warm salmon,
pale cream.

ACCENT:
the crescent moon and small yellow-green cat eyes.

DEPTH

Create depth through:

dark foreground foliage,
roof overlap,
cat placement,
secondary rooftops,
tree layering,
and atmospheric sky recession.

GLOBAL VISUAL LANGUAGE

Preserve one clear visual thesis:

a solitary black cat sits quietly on an old red-tiled village roof at dusk, watching a small crescent moon above warm coral clouds.

The roof provides the visual route.

The cat provides emotional presence.

The sunset provides color contrast.

The moon provides the distant reward.

Keep the scene simple, painterly, quiet, and immediately readable at thumbnail scale.

PAINTERLY STYLE

A flat hand-drawn graphic illustration, 2000s.
